info.name: HAPI FHIR R4 - Core APIs
info.description:
Patient, Practitioner (Doctor/Nurse), Encounter, Appointment APIs for HAPI FHIR JPA Server R4. Base URL: http://localhost:8080/fhir

AUTH: Protected by simple Bearer-token auth. Run 'Auth > Login' first; its script stores the token in {{token}}. The collection sends 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' on every request automatically.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login to obtain a Bearer token (auto-stored in {{token}}), logout to revoke, and a no-token 401 check.
